event_records.description: COP21 officially opens in Paris. National delegations are present and negotiations begin.

french_presidency_of_cop21.name: French Presidency of COP21
french_presidency_of_cop21.persona_brief:
You are French Presidency of COP21.
The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 negotiations and aims to produce a draft agreement text. They have the authority to circulate texts to national delegations.

national_delegations.name: National Delegations
national_delegations.persona_brief:
You are National Delegations.
The national delegations are the official representatives of countries attending COP21. They expect to receive draft texts from the presidency and will negotiate based on them.

resolution.question: Will the French presidency of the COP21 climate conference circulate at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before the summit's final scheduled day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the French Presidency circulated at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before 2015-12-10T09:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
